name: fritzos8-mcp
description: Local MCP server for an AVM FRITZ!Box with FRITZ!OS 8: diagnostics, devices, Wi-Fi, phone and smart home. Read-only by default.
long_description:
Talks to the box in your home network over TR-064, the AHA smart home interface and the web UI's REST API. Starts read-only; write tools need **Allow changes**, and critical actions (reboot, port forwarding, firmware update) additionally need **Allow critical actions** and go through a plan/confirm step. Every write is read back, and passwords, Wi-Fi keys and PINs are never returned.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by AVM / FRITZ! GmbH.

fritz_host.title: FRITZ!Box address
fritz_host.description: Host name or IP address of the box. fritz.box works in most home networks.

fritz_user.title: FRITZ!Box user
fritz_user.description: A dedicated user created under System > FRITZ!Box Users. TR-064 access must be enabled under Home Network > Network > Network Settings.

fritz_password.title: Password
fritz_password.description: Password of that user. Stored encrypted by the app using the operating system's secure storage.

allow_write.title: Allow changes
allow_write.description: Enables write tools such as renaming devices or switching the guest Wi-Fi. Every change is read back.

allow_critical.title: Allow critical actions
allow_critical.description: Reboot, port forwarding, firmware update and similar. Only effective together with Allow changes; each action needs a plan and an explicit confirmation.
